title: Benign Relearning Attack Surface Mapping: Which Fine-Tuning Tasks Most Effectively Undo Unlearning?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly informs unlearning robustness assessment by mapping which downstream tasks undo unlearning. Practical value for designing more robust unlearning objectives.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires applying multiple unlearning methods, then multiple relearning fine-tuning tasks, then extraction evaluation. Each step has its own complexity. The combinatorial experiment matrix is daunting for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: The combinatorial design (3 unlearning methods x N relearning tasks x knowledge categories) is very broad. Even scoped to 1 unlearning method and 3 tasks, setup time for unlearning pipelines alone is substantial.
